hypothesis.description: Match each withheld KST day to historical prefix days using the full public temperature/salinity trajectory compressed into six fixed four-hour bins, then transfer the median hidden profile at the identical KST minute. This tests sequence-state recurrence rather than the failed pointwise analog manifold.

model.daily_public_features: mean of each of eight public channels inside each fixed four-hour bin, yielding 48 values
model.missing_features: fit-prefix median imputation plus one binary missing indicator per feature, yielding 96 distance coordinates
model.robust_scaling: fit-prefix median and IQR/1.349 per coordinate; fall back to standard deviation then one
model.distance: unweighted Euclidean distance after robust scaling and clip to [-12,12]
model.prediction: median target temperature over the five matched historical days at the identical KST minute and target layer, retaining only jointly finite target temp+psal values
model.fallback: sealed Stage-A prediction_mean when day representation or target analog support is insufficient
model.postprocess: pinned public-endpoint isotonic profile projection then CSV float roundtrip
model.learned_parameters_per_cell: prefix feature medians/scales and exact neighbor index only

lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_failed_rank2_point_analog: one neighbor search per complete public day over a 24-hour trajectory, followed by same-minute robust target transfer; no per-timestamp Gaussian projection or local rank-2 affine profile
lineage_disclosure.public_values_within_query_day: offline public covariates only; no hidden target scalar
